snippet.title: Double Fine's Kiln - Dev Direct Reveal
snippet.description:
Double Fine's Kiln is announced to the world via the 2026 Developer Direct, featuring the creative team and exclusive gameplay. 

Game Page: https://www.doublefine.com/games/kiln
Beta Signups: https://www.doublefine.com/beta
Wishlist: https://www.doublefine.com/games/kiln#buynow

Announcing Kiln: An online, multiplayer, pottery party brawler from Double Fine Productions. Grab your friends to assemble a team of colorful spirits, then sculpt ceramic battle armor on a pottery wheel. The size and shape of your pots determine their play-style and abilities—work together to douse the enemy's kiln!

You can find more info about Kiln on our official site, as well as details on how to sign up for our beta testing program (you'll get to play the game before just about anyone else). 

Kiln hits Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Steam, and PS5 in 2026 (yup, THIS YEAR). We can't wait to see you make—and break—your way to victory. See you in The Wedge!
